quotes.text: Higher level undergraduate courses (e.g. course code starting from 4000 & above) have very limited supply and are usually NOT available to exchange students. In order to increase the chances of securing enough courses, incoming exchange students should consider taking courses with course code starting from 1000 to 3000
If you are not successful in gaining placements into these popular courses at the point of offer, you are not able to add these courses during CourseReg
Business and Law courses are only available to students who are invited by NUS Business School and NUS Law respectively to apply for the exchange during the nomination period
not available during application stage but may be available during Course registration
Each semester normally includes 13 weeks of instruction and 2 weeks of examinations
Enrolment in higher level language courses (2XXX and above) will be conditional on the placement test result
During the Online Application, only core BBA courses are available
At least 50% of a student's total course load must consist of Business School courses
Only students who have been offered Business courses during the application stage will be able to see the courses
If you did not secure any of the popular courses during the first round … please do not repeat your request for any of these courses in subsequent rounds
could lead to a Grade 'W' … or 'F' printed on your transcript
no particular course can be guaranteed by NUS
Students are not allowed to read courses with any kind of timetable clashes
up to 23 Units in one course request
To check if the course is offered to Non-Graduating students, refer to the Vacancy Report
Transfer of units is entirely at the discretion of your home university
